summary: The University of Cambridge runs this four-year EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training MRes + PhD in Photonic and Electronic Systems together with University College London (UCL). The programme begins with an MRes year followed by a three-year PhD, starting on 1 October 2027. The course funding deadline is 8 December 2026; the general application deadline is 13 May 2027.
highlights: Four-year programme: an initial MRes year, then a three-year PhD, run with UCL.
Course funding deadline: 8 December 2026; general application deadline: 13 May 2027.
